entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: A cat warrior and crew-member of the skyship Weatherlight, Gerrard's best friend, who loves him and dies protecting him.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Mirri's fellow student under Multani and captain-to-be of the Weatherlight, proclaimed the Korvecdal.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: Mirri's teacher, who gave her and Gerrard a mission to the Deep Country.

entities.name: Rofellos
entities.description: A friend of Mirri and Gerrard who joined the Weatherlight crew and was killed in the attack on Crovax's Estate.

entities.name: Keilic
entities.description: A Chitr'in warrior who tried to charm Mirri and came to blows with Gerrard.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: The Weatherlight's first mate, who carries the wounded Mirri and unconscious Crovax back to the ship.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: The Weatherlight's captain, whom the crew sets out to rescue.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: A Weatherlight crewmember who searches for Gerrard with Mirri and earns her respect.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: The captain of Predator who takes the Legacy artifacts and fights Gerrard in Volrath's Garden.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Leader of the Skyshroud elves who allies with the Weatherlight crew.

entities.name: Selenia
entities.description: A woman Crovax came to Rath to find, who attacks him in the Stronghold.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A man who slays Selenia, is cursed with vampirism, and kills Mirri in Volrath's Garden.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: A Weatherlight crewmember who treats Mirri's wounds.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: The ruler of the Stronghold on Rath, whose shapeshifting minions troubled the crew.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A skyship on a quest to find the Legacy artifacts, crewed by Mirri and Gerrard.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane to which the Weatherlight planeshifted.

entities.name: The Stronghold
entities.description: The fortress on Rath where Sisay was held.

entities.name: Volrath's Garden
entities.description: The garden on Rath into which Mirri and Crovax tumbled.

entities.name: Skyshroud
entities.description: A forest on Rath where the Weatherlight made an emergency landing.

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: A forest where Mirri informed Rofellos's family of his death.

entities.name: Chitr'in
entities.description: A tribe of cat people in the Deep Country.

events.summary: Mirri is born in an unknown forest and banished for having two different eye colors.
events.quote: Mirri was born in an unknown forest where she was banished for having two different eye colors

events.summary: Mirri becomes a student of Multani and befriends Gerrard and Rofellos, falling in love with Gerrard.
events.quote: she eventually became a student of Multani and a friend to Gerrard Capashen and Rofellos

events.summary: On a trade mission to the Chitr'in, Keilic and Gerrard come to blows and Mirri throws herself between them.
events.quote: only stopped when Mirri threw herself between them, seeking to protect Gerrard

events.summary: Mirri walks the Spirit Path, defeats her spirit beast and chooses Gerrard, receiving a prophecy that her path will lead Gerrard to his death.
events.quote: she fought her beast and defeated it, choosing Gerrard in the process

events.summary: Mirri joins the Weatherlight crew with Rofellos and Gerrard to find the Legacy artifacts.
events.quote: Mirri joined the crew of the Skyship Weatherlight in its quest to find the Legacy artifacts

events.summary: After Rofellos is killed, Gerrard leaves the ship and Mirri goes with him, then travels to Llanowar to tell Rofellos's family.
events.quote: Rofellos was killed in the attack on Crovax's Estate

events.summary: Three years later Gerrard asks Mirri to be his Lieutenant and she rejoins the crew to rescue Captain Sisay.
events.quote: Gerrard and Mirri both were instrumental in stopping the rampaging monster

events.summary: On Rath, Greven il-Vec takes the Legacy artifacts and Gerrard falls overboard.
events.quote: they were unable to stop Greven il -Vec from taking the Legacy artifacts

events.summary: Mirri and Hanna search the Skyshroud for Gerrard; Hanna saves Mirri from a shapeshifter and they come to an understanding.
events.quote: Hanna saved Mirri from, earning her Mirri's respect

events.summary: The elves capture Mirri and Hanna, but Gerrard is proclaimed the Korvecdal, leading to an alliance with Eladamri's rebels.
events.quote: leading to an alliance between the crew and the rebels

events.summary: In the Stronghold, Mirri's sense of smell exposes a shapeshifting minion of Volrath disguised as Sisay.
events.quote: Her sense of smell saved the crew from one of Volrath 's shapeshifting minions

events.summary: Mirri dives in front of Crovax to deflect Selenia's strike and is gravely wounded; Crovax slays Selenia and Tahngarth carries both back to the ship.
events.quote: Mirri dove in front of him to deflect one of Selenia's strikes.

events.summary: Mirri sees Crovax sabotaging the Weatherlight's sails, attacks him, and both tumble overboard into Volrath's Garden.
events.quote: She attacked Crovax, causing both of them to tumble overboard into Volrath's Garden .

events.summary: Mirri lets Crovax kill her so that Gerrard will save himself, fulfilling the spirit beast's prophecy.
events.quote: Mirri let Crovax kill her so that Gerrard would save himself.

events.summary: In an alternate reality seen in Planar Chaos, Mirri strikes the killing blow against Selenia, becomes the vampiric Mirri the Cursed, and is abandoned on Rath.
events.quote: it was Mirri who struck the killing blow instead of Crovax
